name: UniformSpaceCat.extension_comp_coe
initialProofState:
X : UniformSpaceCat
Y : CpltSepUniformSpace
f : Quiver.Hom (CpltSepUniformSpace.of (UniformSpace.Completion ↑X)).toUniformSpace Y.toUniformSpace
⊢ Eq (UniformSpaceCat.extensionHom (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp X.completionHom f)) f
decl:
@[simp]
theorem extension_comp_coe {X : UniformSpaceCat} {Y : CpltSepUniformSpace}
    (f : toUniformSpace (CpltSepUniformSpace.of (Completion X)) ⟶ toUniformSpace Y) :
    extensionHom (completionHom X ≫ f) = f := by
  apply Subtype.eq
  funext x
  exact congr_fun (Completion.extension_comp_coe f.property) x
